shard: Colour-space dictionary cells for calibrated, ICCBased, Indexed, Separation, and DeviceN spaces
method: Primary EC3 table captions, cells, footers and actual overlay annotations inspected; cross-checked current parser/consumers, named assertions, prior colour shards and selected ADRs. No tests executed.
scope_correction: CalGray uses Table 62, not Table 63. Tables 63–68 cover CalRGB/Lab/ICCBased profile data; Table 69 is rendering intents, not a colour-space dictionary; Tables 70–72 are DeviceN attributes/process/mixing; Table 73 is colour operators. Tables 69 and 73 are not represented as dictionary tables in this review. Indexed and Separation have inline definitions, not a dedicated table.

table_cells.source: Required [XW,YW,ZW], X/Z positive and Y=1.0.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Parser reads and computes; tests `a_lab_space_is_read_under_its_own_white_point`, `calgray_applies_its_gamma_before_the_white_point`, `calgray_is_a_luminance_and_must_be_encoded_for_the_display`; indirect-field equivalence is tested separately.

table_cells.source: Optional, all nonnegative, default [0,0,0].
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Defaults are explicit in parser; unit `a_cal_spaces_black_point_does_not_move_its_colours` confirms current conversion choice. Gamut mapping policy is chapter 10 and not inferred from this table alone.

table_cells.source: Optional positive number, generally >=1; default 1.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Gamma applied before WhitePoint; direct tests use gamma1/gamma2.2, and CalGray table fixture uses gamma2.2. Invalid nonpositive values fallback is recovery, not source-mandated.

table_cells.source: Required [XW,YW,ZW], X/Z positive, Y=1.0.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: CalRGB parser and literal sample tests exercise D65 values; `calrgb_samples_match_independent_gamma_and_srgb_transfer_values` uses independently derived pixel expectations. Source constraints are producer obligations; no rejection duty asserted.

table_cells.source: Optional nonnegative triple; default zero triple.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Shared parsing/default behavior and calibrated tests; no requirement that gamut-mapping behavior be inferred from 8.6.5 alone.

table_cells.source: Optional three-component gamma array, default [1,1,1].
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Identity and non-identity gamma tests; literal public render test separates CalRGB gamma from DeviceRGB control.

table_cells.source: Optional nine numbers arranged as three columns, default identity.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: `calrgb_reads_its_matrix_one_column_per_component`, asymmetric primaries, and public CalRGB pixels provide non-symmetric controls.

table_cells.source: WhitePoint required and constrained as above; BlackPoint optional/nonnegative/default zero.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Lab anchor colours and `a_lab_space_is_read_under_its_own_white_point`; public CIE-context tests use D50 calculations.

table_cells.source: Optional four numbers for a*/b*, default [-100,100,-100,100]; L* stays [0,100]. Input outside range adjusted without error indication.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Parser default and clamp; `lab_maps_its_anchor_colours`, `components_outside_their_range_are_clamped`, DCT Lab and ICC profile range fixtures exercise independent literal anchors.

table_cells.source: Lab shall not specify explicit decoding functions or matrix coefficients; transformation is implicit by its equations.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Current representation uses fixed Lab transform; invalid producer fields do not create a claim of reader rejection.

table_cells.source: Required integer 1,3,4 and matches actual ICC profile component count.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: ICC parser derives channel count from profile; current fixtures include gray/RGB/CMYK and Lab-channel profiles. Table writer constraint is not treated as a universal rejection algorithm.

table_cells.source: Optional; used if embedded profile not supported; matching component count, not Pattern; absent route falls back to DeviceGray/RGB/CMYK by N; no tint transformation; values first constrained to ICC Range then alternate range.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: `crates/pdf-model/tests/icc_alternate_range_spec_audit.rs::unsupported_icc2_profile_clamps_to_icc_range_before_wider_alternate` is the executed public model/render consumer assertion for this cell. It compares the unsupported-profile fallback against both a directly clamped Lab control and an unclamped control. Durable parent review records confirmed finding 2038-B25: observed RGB [255,0,128], expected clamped control [255,0,126]. The ICC2 v5 Lab profile was validated independently by ICC iccDEV2.3.2.5 (ValidationStatus.OK, empty report); this is an executed finding, not an outstanding draft.

table_cells.source: Optional 2*N bounds matching profile; default component defaults/ranges; constrain source values before alternate clamp.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: `an_icc_spaces_range_decides_what_its_operands_mean`, profile range handling and ICC Table68 defaults; alternate-fallback clamp remains the specifically recorded gap, distinct from supported profile path.

table_cells.source: Optional metadata stream.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Not consumed for colour calculations; §14.3 metadata audit owns reading/preservation obligations.

table_cells.source: EC3 #181 revises framing from PDF-version→ICC-document-edition to ICC profile-header version classes, including 2.x and 4.x; readers support ICC.1:2010 required for PDF2 and should interpret by profile header.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: `icc.rs` reads header major version and selects v2/v4 profile decoding; v2/v4 profile tests. Version-sensitive reading is not keyed to PDF version.

table_cells.source: Writer profiles for calibrated graphics spaces shall have listed deviceClass/colorSpace fields, both listed values, and conform to profile-header version.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Parser uses class/channel/PCS/tag validation to decide support; this is chiefly writer validity and accepted later-version fallback is conditional on capability, not proof every writer constraint is checked.

table_cells.source: Typical Gray/RGB/CMYK use [0,1]; ICC Lab L* [0,100], a*/b* [-128,127]. ICC components default to 0.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Profile.component_range and ICC Lab direct/sample fixtures use non-unit range. Table65 explicit /Range overrides where appropriate. Differentiate profile’s ICC-defined actual range from Table68 typical ranges.

table_cells.source: Four-element [/Indexed base hival lookup]; base any device/CIE or Separation/DeviceN, not Pattern or Indexed; stroking/nonstroking current color initializes to 0.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Colour parser; public Indexed initial-zero/regression, lookup through device/Lab/ICC/Separation bases, group/image consumers. Prior `indexed_lab_lookup_spec_audit` and `indexed_rounding_initial_spec_audit` have exact public controls.

table_cells.source: Integer 0–255; lookup bytes/stream m*(hival+1) with consecutive components, scaled [0,255] to base ranges.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Parser and color tests; `indexed_out_of_range` checks source case but may early-return if corpus fixture absent; handbuilt exact-xref controls in indexed ICC and initial tints complement it.

table_cells.source: Index should be integer and within range; real values rounded nearest with .5 up; out of range clamps nearest.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Public `indexed_fractional_rounding_and_clamping_are_lookup_semantics` plus new exact fixture for half-up and initial index; tests contain lower/upper controls.

table_cells.source: Four-element [/Separation name alternateSpace tintTransform], one tint [0,1], initial stroking/nonstroking tint=1; All/None required support.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Public initial tints and explicit tint1/0 controls; `the_none_colourant_marks_nothing`, `the_all_colourant_is_a_complemented_tint`; valid alternate and function behavior.

table_cells.source: Name names requested colorant; subtractive device may directly apply available colorant and ignore alternate/function; additive device always uses alternate; unavailable subtractive colorant uses alternate/function. All/None ignore parameters (which still must have valid values).
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Default display uses alternate path; simulation API/native process route has separate controls. Local RGB display is not evidence for physical subtractive availability; native hardware mapping remains a host/device boundary.

table_cells.source: Alternate allowed any device/CIE space, not special spaces; tint transform maps one tint to its component count.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Tint colors and one/multi-output function tests, NoColorant alternate; shading/function audits cover function numerics separately.

table_cells.source: Four/five element array; arbitrary component count subject to implementation limits; names are distinct except None may repeat; All forbidden; CMYK names reserved. Component values [0,1], initial each=1.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Parser counts names/components; tests cover five colorants, None duplicate, All/None, initial tint and mapped order. Resource cap is local, not normative.

table_cells.source: Allowed device/CIE alternate, not special space. Function receives n tint values and returns m alternate values; fallback approximates unavailable components.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Function tint and alternate path tests include literal pixels and component order. Additive display vs simulated/native routes are policy-specific and traced in prior special-space shard.

table_cells.source: Optional, DeviceN/NChannel; default DeviceN. NChannel activates richer attributes.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: `a_devicen_subtype_keeps_its_tint_transform`, process-only NChannel and NChannel spot tests; default DeviceN controls.

table_cells.source: Required for NChannel with spot components, otherwise optional; values are Separation spaces named by matching key; NChannel requires all spot colorants, may include extras.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Colorants name matching positive/mismatch controls; `an_nchannel_spot_component_keeps_the_tint_transform`, simulation spot route. Extra entries and every structurally invalid map not exhaustively tested.

table_cells.source: Required for NChannel with process components, otherwise optional; one process space max; process space values and component-name mapping in Table71.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Process order/mapping, CMYK subset, ICC process profile and process-only no-tint-transform tests. ADR1103 route has valid and independent mapping controls.

table_cells.source: Optional. Provides optional blending attributes where processor uses custom mixing instead of tint-transform path.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: No generic mixing-hints application in current consumer; source explicitly says processor need not use hints. This absence alone is not a failure.

table_cells.source: Required device/CIE except Lab; ICCBased requires appropriate calibration.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Process parser accepts valid device and ICC cases; Lab exclusion is validated in code. No producer-conformance checker claim.

table_cells.source: Required ordered component-name array; names correspond to process components and match DeviceN names, even when not all process components present.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Tests distinguish nonidentity name mapping and omitted CMYK components; non-CMYK completeness/order is source-derived.

table_cells.source: Optional number 0–1 per name; Default applies to unspecified; absent Default defaults to zero, interactive processors may choose others. If Solidities appears, PrintingOrder required.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Generic mixing hints need not be used; no assertion that current reader applies solidities. This is permitted omission.

table_cells.source: Required when Solidities appears; includes every DeviceN component name, may include extras; order is independent of names-array order.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: Not consumed because no DeviceN mixing-hints algorithm is selected; no reader duty to expose/use it established here.

table_cells.source: Optional per-colorant function 0..1, optional Default; processors may ignore values with other dot-gain sources.
table_cells.implementation_assertions: No generic mixing-hints path; clause says optional information and processor may ignore it, so not a missing must-behavior.

errata.source: §8.6.5.5, physical206–207 / printed191–192; actual issue annotations inspected on both pages.
errata.effect: Reframes version support around ICC profile header version classes, “both 2.x and 4.x”; current ICC parsing is by header version.
Adds NOTE 2: private ICC tags are intentionally unspecified and may be ignored; implementation need not use private data.

errata.source: §8.6.5.8 Table69, physical212 / printed197, outside this dictionary family.
errata.effect: Withdraws NOTE permission to support fewer than four rendering intents; prior default_colour_bpc shard covers it, so not recertified here.

Caret says None shall not be used in NChannel; struck rule had allowed None only in non-NChannel. This constrains producers. Existing Separation/DeviceN None reader paths are not an assertion that invalid NChannel/None must be rejected.

coverage_conclusion: Selected color dictionary cells map to prior literal assertions. Existing B25 ICC fallback Range failure remains current and is not duplicated. No additional valid-input draft warranted. MixingHints may be ignored; all reviews remain partial.
limits: Does not certify all color conversions, every ICC profile class/version/tag, every default resource context, actual subtractive-device native colorant availability, all NChannel permutations, or the full separation simulation formula.
Producer validity cells and reader duties are kept separate; accepting invalid white points, malformed type-specific values, or forbidden names is not itself a demonstrated required reader failure.
Table 69 rendering-intent names and Table 73 color-setting operator cells were excluded; adjacent shards own those features.
